standard_prerequisites.name: Necessitation rule
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every normal modal logic is closed under the rule Necessitation: from A derive Box A.
standard_prerequisites.use: The basis case n=1 of the induction is exactly Necessitation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Axiom K and modus ponens
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every normal modal logic contains all instances of Box(A implies B) implies (Box A implies Box B) and is closed under modus ponens and tautological reasoning.
standard_prerequisites.use: The inductive step combines the induction hypothesis with the K instance for the final implication and closes by modus ponens with suitable tautological instances.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1045-1054): every normal modal logic is closed under RK - from A_1 implies (A_2 implies ... (A_{n-1} implies A_n)...) derive Box A_1 implies (Box A_2 implies ... (Box A_{n-1} implies Box A_n)...).
Induction basis (proof lines 1056-1060): for n=1 the rule is exactly Necessitation, under which every normal modal logic is closed.

Inductive step (proof lines 1061-1082): assume A_1 implies (... (A_{n-1} implies A_n)...) in Sigma; the induction hypothesis gives Box A_1 implies (... Box(A_{n-1} implies A_n)...); since Sigma contains the K instance Box(A_{n-1} implies A_n) implies (Box A_{n-1} implies Box A_n), modus ponens with suitable tautological instances yields Box A_1 implies (... (Box A_{n-1} implies Box A_n)...) in Sigma.
proof_roadmap: Set up induction on n with the n=1 case identical to Necessitation.
Apply the induction hypothesis to the implication chain of length n-1.
Close with the K instance for the last box and modus ponens.
